name: Cau Hai brick crab
summary: Brick crab sold at chợ Cầu Hai. Thanh Niên, 14 March 2016, describes a thin shell and red roe, and says Huế restaurants advertise “cua gạch Cầu Hai”. No recipe is printed. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Chợ Cầu Hai, on the lagoon before Bach Ma. Thanh Niên, 14 March 2016, names the crab there.
texture: Thanh Niên describes a thin shell and red roe.
taste: Thanh Niên calls the crab sweet, and the roe sweet.
howToEat: Buy it at the market and cook it later. Thanh Niên says people from Huế and Đà Nẵng do that, often for the weekend. No recipe is printed.
A price is Check on arrival. A market hour is Check on arrival.
where: Chợ Cầu Hai, on National Highway 1A, about 40 km south of Huế, facing the lagoon. Thanh Niên does not name a stall.
seoTitle: Cau Hai brick crab — thin shell, red roe
seoDescription: Cua gạch Cầu Hai is the lagoon crab at chợ Cầu Hai. Thanh Niên describes a thin shell and red roe. No recipe is printed. A price is Check on arrival.
